n: The final Song of Ascents. Pilgrims leaving the temple call on the priests and Levites who serve through the night to keep praising the Lord.

f.w: which by night stand in the house of the LORD

n: ‘Lift your hands toward the holy place and bless the Lord’ — raised hands were a gesture of prayer and praise.
The priests answer with a blessing on the departing pilgrim: may the Creator of heaven and earth bless you from Zion. The worshipers who came for blessing go home blessed.
